ask: Skip a renew button, or add a Try again button to the sign-in note?
problem: On the web app, when the page cannot renew its sign-in, the Inbox counts fail and the badge showed nothing. Nothing told people why.
found: The app already shows an Offline icon in the My Work header. But it called a blocked sign-in 'offline' too, or said nothing. Code only; no live logs. An expired sign-in is LAN-243's.
changed: Nothing new since last time: grey badge, plus a header note saying the sign-in was not renewed. No new button.
why: Apps renew sign-in silently and retry; people rarely tap for it. The Sync screen already has Sync now. A sign-in that truly expired is LAN-243's, and asks to sign in again.
touches: A button would need new words in all 16 languages and a new place on the screen.

options.label: No button
options.result: The note explains, the app retries by itself, and Sync now is one tap away. This is the usual way.

options.label: Add Try again
options.result: A button on the note retries at once. Faster, but one more control for a fault that heals itself.
